label: utilityFactor
comment: An indicator of durability defined as the lifetime (typically measures as usage cycles) for this product divided by the industry average. For example a battery with a 10,000 cycle lifetime where industry average is 5,000 cycles will have a durability factor of 2. If unknown set to 1 or omit.

domainIncludes.comment: High level circularity information about this product.  Note that this does not substitute for detailed product circularity data sheet (PCDS) criteria which would be represented as a self-issued UNTP Digital Conformity Credential as a set of assessments against individual ISO PCDS criteria.
